Remark
[Constant-length fields are orthogonal to their covariant derivative]

Source: petersen:page-0090 ↗ def:pet-ch2-covariant-derivative-tensor

1. ch2:2.5.17If $X$ has constant length, then $g( abla _ZX,X)=0$ for every $Z$. \sketch Metric compatibility gives $D_Zg(X,X)=2g( abla _ZX,X)$, and the left side vanishes.
